text:
alex kim: Quick preflight check — we need the version bump and changelog pushed before the cutoff at 18:00 PT. Is release/2.4 branch ready for the cut?

maya patel: I merged the feature PRs earlier but left the changelog draft in #679, planning to finalize in 15m. @alex kim can you verify the bump PR?

alex kim: Yep I opened the bump PR (#678). It's just the semver and upgrade notes. Command I used: `./scripts/version/bump.sh 2.4.0-rc1`

noah reyes: Running a green sweep now. Kicking off parallel jobs with `scripts/ci/green_sweep.sh --parallel 6`. Will post failures. :wrench:

ci-bot: CI started for branch release/2.4 (run id: 2026-08-14-021). Tests: unit, integration, smoke.

ci-bot: unit-1: ✅ green, unit-2: ✅ green, integration-1: ❌ flaky-failure (1/3), smoke: ✅ green

sara liu: Noted one flaky in integration: tests/load/test_cache.py::test_cache_eviction — seen intermittently on 3090 pools. @jules any idea?

jules: That one regressed after the KV cache refactor. Short-term: add a retry wrapper in the CI job for that test or mark xfail on GPU pools. Long-term: fix the race in KVStore.patch().

noah reyes: Pushing a workaround to CI to auto-retry flaky tests twice. Patch in CI job: ```yaml
steps:
  - name: run-integration
    run: ./run_integration.sh || (sleep 5 && ./run_integration.sh)
```

alex kim: Fine as mitigation. Make sure we include a changelog note about the workaround and add a follow-up ticket for the race fix (#701).

maya patel: Changelog updated and PR description now includes the CI retry note. Also added the ticket link. Ready to merge once CI stabilizes.

ci-bot: integration-1: ✅ green after retry. Full pipeline: ✅ all checks passed.

alex kim: Great — I'll merge bump PR and tag once merge CI passes. Reminder: do not squash the changelog commit (preserve author).

noah reyes: Merged release/2.4 at 1812345800, tagging 2.4.0-rc1 now. `git tag -a v2.4.0-rc1 -m "RC1: pre-cutoff"`

maya patel: Changelog PR merged. Sending release notes draft to #announcements for copy review.

jules: I'll open the follow-up bugfix PR for KVStore race early tomorrow and add the flaky test to flaky-tracker.

alex kim: Thanks all — team, if you see any late PRs that need to ride the train, ping me directly. If nothing else, cutoff stands at 18:00 PT. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: deploy-bot scheduled release job at 18:05 PT (after manual approval) — waiting for ops approval.
